args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

Replaced ROUND_HALF_UP with ROUND_HALF_EVEN in src/money.py so the
implementation matches its documented behavior and the expectations
in tests/test_money.py, fixing the nightly build failure.

args.head: fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`round_money()` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` while its docstring, FIN-212, and `tests/test_money.py` expect banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `test_half_even`.

## Changes
- Import and apply `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `src/money.py`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on the branch passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

Fixes the nightly build failure; needs ship in today's release, so requesting code-owner review/merge.
